title: Tripartite information of free fermions: a universal entanglement coefficient from the sine kernel
summary: We study the tripartite information I_3 of free fermions on two-dimensional lattices partitioned into three adjacent strips of width w. Translation invariance yields the exact decomposition I_3 = \sum_{k_y} g(k_F(k_y) w), where g(z) is a universal function of the scaling variable z = k_F w, determined by the spectrum of the sine-kernel (Slepian) integral operator. We find that g(z) has a unique zero at z* = 1.329 +/- 0.001: modes with k_F w 0), while modes with k_F w > z* satisfy it (g < 0).
